brief: User-supplied animation queue: 27 letters, 15 marks, 100 English-gloss concepts.
letter_picture_mapping: Uses the existing round-one picture subjects: three-candle cake, house and ball, Noa handstand, tent, lamp, kite, vine, table, yo-yo, diving board, hut, magnet, cat, cushion, eye, mouth, pizza, ball, camel, zipper, gate and teapot, plus final-form variants. These are visual mnemonics, not etymology or sound claims.
glyph_method: Local installed Hebrew glyph outlines converted to self-contained absolute integer path contours. No font dependency remains in SVG files.
mark_reference: Read-only project data/pronunciation/niqqud.json positional descriptions and Israeli values. The current queue supplies the explicit 15-item mapping that was absent from the previous twelve-picture task.
phonetic_limitations: Mouth shapes are schematic cues only. They do not encode tongue position, airflow or reliable pronunciation. Kamatz here represents kamatz gadol; other contexts differ. Shva varies by context. Dagesh is not a vowel and has no single sound. Shin-dot and sin-dot are consonant marks, not vowels. All Phase B items carry review doubts.
calendar_convention: Seven positions read left to right, top row then bottom row, Sunday first. A check shape marks the selected position so colour is not the only distinction. Today and tomorrow are relative illustrative positions, not live dates.
motion: Fixed fill colours per path; monotonic opacity and geometry transitions. No flashing or repeated colour switching. Renderer must honor reduced motion by displaying the final still only.
